rows.name: age_slack
rows.source: min over both directions of min(partner.age - age_min, age_max - partner.age), from observed fields

rows.name: soft_equal
rows.source: count of SOFT fields both observed and equal (greedy's own score)

rows.name: soft_differ
rows.source: count of SOFT fields both observed and unequal

rows.name: soft_missing
rows.source: count of SOFT fields unobserved for either member

rows.name: soft_declined
rows.source: count of SOFT fields with field_status=='declined' for either member

rows.name: goal_agree
rows.source: 1 if both relationship_goal observed and equal, else 0

rows.name: prev_intros_mean
rows.source: mean over the two members of past introduction counts (state['introductions'])

rows.name: hist_yes
rows.source: count of feedback events (state['feedback'], observed_day <= day) with positive value involving a or b: response 'yes' / date True / second 'yes'

rows.name: degree_a
rows.source: number of feasible candidate partners member a has in the current state graph
